exact_blockers.requirement: Provide exact licensed VoiceBank+DEMAND, VOiCES, and DNS5 archives/manifests/selected files with SHA-256, byte counts, and frozen cohort definitions.
Record explicit per-track rights, publication/cache scope, and audio-publication boundaries; do not broaden DNS5/VOiCES/VoiceBank scope beyond approved records.
Freeze separate paired, real-room, and acquisition-only protocols with scorer identity, alignment/resampling, and non-pooling rules.
Provide pinned scorer/runtime implementations, lockfiles, deterministic commands, and verified outputs for each claimed track.
Execute frozen held-out cohorts with controls, invalid/missing/nonfinite handling, and per-item failure accounting; keep tracks separate.
Define an optional SDK developer/evidence adapter boundary that preserves installed v0 behavior and is not exposed as a processor/default.
Collect paced target runtime/resource/deadline/availability evidence for the exact workload.
Record explicit release/public benchmark/listening/default-selection approval; missing evidence cannot qualify.

gates.requirement: Exact VoiceBank+DEMAND, VOiCES, and DNS5 source/archive/manifest identities, hashes, byte counts, selected-file provenance, and frozen cohort definitions are pinned and locally present.

Acquisition, local evaluation, public aggregate reporting, cache, redistribution, derivative-output, and audio-publication rights are explicitly scoped and approved per track; public cache/publication scope is never broadened silently.
Paired scoring, real-room robustness, and acquisition-only/non-intrusive tracks remain separated with frozen protocols, scoring boundaries, and no pooled ranking.
Pinned scorer implementations/weights/runtimes, deterministic commands, and byte-level or explicitly toleranced verified outputs reproduce without network or hidden mutation.
Frozen held-out cohorts, controls, invalid/missing/nonfinite handling, alignment/resampling policy, and per-item failure accounting are present and independently verified.
Any future SDK developer/evidence adapter is optional, task-local or separately reviewed, preserves installed v0 behavior, and is not exposed as a processor or default.
Target-device/runtime execution, pacing, CPU/memory, deadline, and availability evidence are collected for the exact intended workload; no device timing is claimed without it.
Explicit default-selection, release, public benchmark, listening, and publication approvals are recorded; missing evidence cannot qualify.

reproduction.comparison: canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 only; no tolerance
